Class PacketLogEntry

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.model.PacketLogEntry
public class PacketLogEntry extends Object
One LoRa packet log entry shown in the packet monitor. The instance is immutable for packet data; only id is filled after the entry is inserted into the database.

  • Constructor Details

    • PacketLogEntry

      public PacketLogEntry(String ownerNodeId, long capturedAt, PacketLogEntry.Direction direction, String packetType, String transportMechanism, String fromNode, String toNode, String payloadText, byte[] packetBytes)
      Creates a packet log entry.
      Parameters:
      ownerNodeId - local owner node id this entry belongs to
      capturedAt - capture time in Unix epoch milliseconds
      direction - packet direction
      packetType - packet type or portnum as presented in the UI
      transportMechanism - transport mechanism as presented in the UI
      fromNode - sender as presented in the UI
      toNode - recipient as presented in the UI
      payloadText - textual payload shown in the table
      packetBytes - serialized MeshPacket; the array is copied
